notes: Partition verified: 18 source and 26 target ids each once.

The μή/τις pair is rightly split rather than joined. Rule 59 joins a negator with a plain indefinite only where a single English negative word answers to both tokens (nothing); here the ASV wrote two words and man answers to the indefinite separately, so rule 45's closing clause and rule 2 apply. The joined reading is named in the review note.

s014, s016 and s018 head on feast, moon and sabbath respectively — rule 17's generic-noun clause for the supplied day, and rule 66's gloss test for new moon, where moon glosses the μην- element rather than completing it.
ἐν μέρει is not a rule 67 supplied frame: μέρει is an expressed Greek noun glossed respect, so the ordinary three-way split stands.
